summaryZh: Komiyama 实验室研究大量神经元如何协同控制动物行为，以及这些神经元群体在环境经验、技能学习、记忆形成和疾病状态中如何改变。研究结合行为、遗传、成像与电生理技术。
researchQuestions: 大量神经元如何协同控制动物行为？
神经元群体如何随环境经验、技能学习和记忆形成而改变？
这些活动在疾病状态中如何受损？
topics: 神经元群体与行为控制
疾病状态下的神经活动

evidence.quote: We want to know how this large ensemble of neurons works coherently to control an animal’s behavior. We want to know how it might change when animals experience the environment, learn new skills and form new memories. We want to know how it might be compromised in diseased states.
We are combining behavioral, genetic, imaging and electrophysiological techniques to tackle these questions.
